sources.title: Frozen apple task reference
sources.content: The specified apple appears red. Its skin reflects relatively more long wavelength visible light than shorter wavelength light. Perception depends jointly on illumination and surface reflectance and the observer. A changed coating or measurement process is a separate conditional scenario.

sources.title: Synthetic apple reasoning fixture - not a scientific source
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC PROTOCOL FIXTURE. Authored for software demonstration; not a retrieved scientific publication.
Apparent surface color depends jointly on illumination and wavelength selective surface response and the observer.
For the fixed red specimen under broad white illumination the described selective surface response supports the red conclusion.
Changing viewing or surface conditions defines a separate scenario and does not establish its conclusion for the fixed task.
A specified surface modification could change apparent color and should be tested by comparison under fixed observation conditions.
The proposed surface modification is conditional and has not been performed on the present specimen.
